chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Is'haq ibn 'Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

There does not follow the man after his death except for three qualities: a charity he made flow for the Sake of Allah during his lifetime, so it flows for him after his death; and a Sunnah of guidance which he enacted so it is acted upon after his death; and a righteous child who supplicates for him.

key_terms.سُنَّةُ هُدًى: A guiding tradition or practice established by the person that others continue to follow
key_terms.صَدَقَةٌ: Charity, specifically ongoing charity that continues to yield reward after death

ai.seo_question: What three things continue to benefit a person after death according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) categorizes the enduring rewards of the deceased into three specific streams: ongoing charity, beneficial knowledge or practices (sunnah), and righteous offspring. Shia scholars emphasize that these elements represent the continuity of one's spiritual legacy, transforming transient worldly actions into eternal blessings. This framework underscores the Shia emphasis on active legacy-building through both material charity and intellectual/spiritual guidance.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘There does not follow the man after his death except for three qualities – a charity he made it to flow for the Sake of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> during his lifetime, so it would flow for him after his death; and a Sunnah guidance which he enacted so it would be acted upon after his death; and a righteous child who would supplicate for him’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

Nothing follows a deceased after his death except three things: a charity that Allah has made to function in his life time which continues after his death, a Sunnah of guidance that one establishes which is acted upon after his death and virtuous children who pray for him.’”
